svg.text: STAGE 516 · TOPIC 156 · P1025–P1026 🎉 · SVG 160 🎉 · 158th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 160th SVG & 1,035th GUARDRAIL DUAL MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 8083 / RFC 3550 Circuit Breakers (RTP-CB) Zombie Reaper & Audio-First Fallback Guard
⛔ Misconfigured RFC 8083 Path (Zombie Leak & False Call Drop)
1. Unbounded RTCP Timeout (20 Intervals = 100s Zombie GPU Leak)
Client crashes without BYE -> 14 zombie RTP flows stay open
• AI Voice Agent keeps synthesizing & streaming RTP into blackhole
• Exhausts expensive S2S / Avatar GPU concurrency slots
2. Single-Interval Congestion False Trip on 1.5s Elevator Fade
1 RTCP RR with fraction_lost=45% -> Immediate CB Teardown!
• Violates RFC 8083 §4.3 multi-interval persistence requirement
• Drops active customer calls during normal Wi-Fi / 5G handovers
3. Killing 24 kbps Voice Instead of Shedding 1.5 Mbps Video
Bandwidth drops to 100 kbps -> Whole BUNDLE session killed!
• Fails to decouple high-bitrate video from narrowband Opus audio
• Terminates voice call even when 100 kbps easily supports Opus
✅ Deterministic RFC 8083 Guardrails (P1025 + P1026 🎉)
P1025 (1,034th Guardrail): [3, 5]-Interval Timeout Zombie Reaper
action: "trip_rfc8083_timeout_circuit_breaker_and_reap_zombie_flow"
• Reaps dead RTP flows after [3, 5] missing RTCP SR/RR intervals
• clampedUnterminatedZombieRtpFlows = 0 (zero GPU slot leaks)
• clampedMaxConsecutiveMissingRtcpIntervals in [3, 5] intervals
Policy: P1025-WEBRTC-RFC8083-RTCP-TIMEOUT-AND-MEDIA-TIMEOUT-CIRCUIT-BREAKER-GUARD
P1026 🎉 (160th SVG & 1,035th Guardrail!): [3, 6] Intervals & Audio-First
action: "shed_video_layers_first_and_require_consecutive_cb_intervals"
• Requires [3, 6] consecutive congested RTCP intervals before trip
• Sheds avatar video first; preserves 24 kbps Opus AI voice track
• clampedPrematureVoiceSessionTerminations = 0 (zero false drops)
Policy: P1026-WEBRTC-RFC8083-CONGESTION-CIRCUIT-BREAKER-AUDIO-FIRST-DEGRADATION-GUARD
